intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetryEvent without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Shared kernel of Intake/Ledger integration. Published language: sealed interface TelemetryEvent with Instant occurredAt() and nested records TelemetrySampleValidated(TelemetrySample sample, Instant occurredAt), TelemetrySampleValidationFailed(TelemetrySample sample, Instant occurredAt), TelemetryBackfillReordered(TelemetrySample sample, Instant occurredAt), TelemetryWindowBuffered(List<TelemetrySample> samples, Instant windowStart, Instant windowEnd, Instant occurredAt), TelemetryRevisionAppended(UUID recordId, int revisionNumber, Instant occurredAt). Records are non-null and immutable (lists copied).
